claims.explanation: SC-9 is a naphthalenesulfonamide PKC activator that kills cells dependent on PKC signaling, and the selective pattern is best explained by loss of negative regulators of the PKC/RAS-MAPK pathway (TP53, CDKN2A, PTEN, NF1) combined with activating RAS/RAF mutations, which together create PKC-addicted, apoptosis-prone states. Lines with intact tumor suppressors or alternative survival signaling (e.g., ARID1A/SMARCA4-mutant, ALK-fusion, or PBRM1/VHL-mutant lines) are relatively protected. The transcriptional response (PRKCH, PLCB3, MYLK up; PCNA down) supports PKC-pathway engagement and growth arrest.

features.basis: TP53 mutation is nearly universal among selectively killed lines and absent in several protected lines; loss of p53-mediated apoptosis lowers the threshold for PKC-driven death
KRAS-mutant lines (OV7, RKN, NCIH1792, PATU8988T, KPNSI9S) are enriched among sensitive lines, consistent with PKC/RAS-MAPK co-dependency
BRAF-mutant melanomas (UACC62, SH4, K029AX) are selectively killed, suggesting MAPK-pathway addiction sensitizes to PKC activation
CDKN2A loss appears in sensitive lines (MHHES1, K029AX) and is absent from several protected lines, consistent with loss of cell-cycle checkpoint control
PTEN-mutant lines (UACC62, FTC133) are among the most killed, consistent with PI3K/AKT-driven survival dependence being disrupted by PKC activation
NF1 loss (BICR6, FTC133) hyperactivates RAS-MAPK and tracks with sensitivity
SC-9 directly activates PKC (annotated target PRKCA), so higher PKC-pathway expression/activity should increase drug effect
PRKCH is upregulated in the virtual-cell response to SC-9, indicating PKC-family signaling engagement in responsive cells
ARID1A mutation is enriched in the least-affected lines (KU1919, HS766T, GP2D, MDAMB175VII), suggesting SWI/SNF loss buffers against PKC-induced death
SMARCA4-mutant lines (COV434, SKNSH) are relatively unaffected, consistent with chromatin-remodeling loss conferring resistance
ALK-altered lines (NCIH2452, KELLY, SKNSH) include protected neuroblastoma/mesothelioma lines, suggesting ALK-driven survival signaling overrides PKC activation
PBRM1-mutant KMRC1 is among the least affected lines, consistent with SWI/SNF subunit loss reducing sensitivity
